content: Microcontroller Driver (MCU) The MCU driver initializes clocks, PLLs, RAM sections, and low-power modes of the microcontroller core. function Mcu_Init [SWS_CP_MCAL_00001] void Mcu_Init(const Mcu_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the MCU clock tree, oscillator settings, and resets internal peripheral registers. Port and Digital I/O Drivers (PORT & DIO) Configures physical pin multiplexing, directions, and read/write states for digital general-purpose pins. function Port_Init [SWS_CP_MCAL_00002] void Port_Init(const Port_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes all pin directions, electrical pull-up/pull-down settings, and pin modes (GPIO, CAN, SPI, UART). function Dio_ReadChannel [SWS_CP_MCAL_00004] Dio_LevelType Dio_ReadChannel(Dio_ChannelType ChannelId); Returns the digital input voltage level (STD_HIGH or STD_LOW) of the specified I/O channel. function Dio_WriteChannel [SWS_CP_MCAL_00005] void Dio_WriteChannel(Dio_ChannelType ChannelId, Dio_LevelType Level); Drives the output voltage level (STD_HIGH or STD_LOW) of the specified I/O channel. SPI and Analog-to-Digital Converter Drivers (SPI & ADC) Provides high-speed synchronous serial communication and multi-channel analog voltage sampling. function Spi_SyncTransmit [SWS_CP_MCAL_00007] Std_ReturnType Spi_SyncTransmit(Spi_SequenceType Sequence); Synchronously transmits and receives data for the specified SPI channel sequence. function Adc_StartGroupConversion [SWS_CP_MCAL_00009] void Adc_StartGroupConversion(Adc_GroupType Group); Triggers analog-to-digital conversion for all analog input channels assigned to the specified group. Hardware Watchdog Driver (WDG) Controls the hardware watchdog timer register, window times, and reset triggers. function Wdg_SetMode [SWS_CP_MCAL_00010] Std_ReturnType Wdg_SetMode(WdgIf_ModeType Mode); Switches watchdog driver mode (WDGIF_OFF_MODE, WDGIF_SLOW_MODE, WDGIF_FAST_MODE).
